enriched.title: Past Simple e Past Continuous com Vocabulário Cotidiano
enriched.summary: Nesta aula, os alunos praticam o uso do Past Simple e do Past Continuous para descrever eventos passados e simultâneos. Além disso, a aula apresenta um vocabulário relacionado a alimentos, cozinha e situações do dia a dia.

vocabulary.definition: The middle of the day, around 12:00 PM.
examples: I will meet you at midday. (Eu vou te encontrar ao meio-dia.)

vocabulary.definition: To behave as if something is true when it is not.
examples: He pretended to be asleep. (Ele fingiu estar dormindo.)

vocabulary.definition: To have a plan or purpose in mind.
examples: She intends to move abroad next year. (Ela pretende se mudar para o exterior no próximo ano.)

vocabulary.definition: A black or dark brown substance used as fuel.
examples: The house is heated with coal. (A casa é aquecida com carvão.)
Do you have enough money? (Você tem dinheiro suficiente?)

vocabulary.definition: Cheese that has been stored for a period of time to develop flavor.
examples: I love the taste of aged cheese. (Eu amo o sabor de queijo maturado.)

vocabulary.definition: An oven that uses coal as fuel.
examples: They baked the pizza in a coal-fired oven. (Eles assaram a pizza em um forno a lenha.)

vocabulary.definition: A sweet made from milk and sugar.
examples: She bought some milk candy from the store. (Ela comprou doce de leite na loja.)

grammar.explanation: The Past Simple is used for actions that were completed in the past, while the Past Continuous describes actions that were ongoing at a specific point in the past.
rules: Use Past Simple for completed actions: subject + verb (past form).
Use Past Continuous for ongoing actions: subject + was/were + verb-ing.
When combining the two, the Past Continuous often sets the scene, while the Past Simple describes the interrupting action.
examples: The baker dropped the tray while he was taking the fresh bread out of the oven.
The students were whispering to each other when the teacher walked into the classroom.
commonMistakes: Using Past Simple for both actions when one is ongoing: 'I walked to the store when it rained.'
Using Past Continuous for both actions when one interrupts the other: 'I was walking to the store when it was raining.'

expressions.usage: Used to describe an activity that lasts throughout the entire day.
examples: He worked all day long. (Ele trabalhou o dia todo.)

expressions.usage: Used to indicate a minimum amount or level.
examples: You should eat at least one fruit per day. (Você deve comer pelo menos uma fruta por dia.)

practiceQuestions.question: The baker / drop / the tray / while / he / take / the fresh bread / out of the oven.
practiceQuestions.answer: The baker dropped the tray while he was taking the fresh bread out of the oven.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence uses Past Simple for the completed action (dropped) and Past Continuous for the ongoing action (was taking).

practiceQuestions.question: While / the CEO / deliver / her speech / the microphone / stop / working.
practiceQuestions.answer: While the CEO was delivering her speech, the microphone stopped working.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Past Continuous (was delivering) sets the scene, and the Past Simple (stopped) describes the interrupting action.

culturalNotes: O uso de fornos a lenha é comum em pizzarias tradicionais na Itália e em outros países, criando um sabor único.
O doce de leite, conhecido como 'dulce de leche' em espanhol, é popular em vários países da América Latina.
studyTips: Pratique o uso de Past Simple e Past Continuous juntos para descrever situações do dia a dia.
Crie frases com as novas palavras do vocabulário para reforçar o aprendizado.
Leia em voz alta as frases de exemplo para melhorar a pronúncia.
originalExamples: The baker dropped the tray while he was taking the fresh bread out of the oven. (O padeiro derrubou a bandeja enquanto ele estava tirando o pão fresco do forno.)
The chef was preparing the signature dish when he burned his finger. (O chef estava preparando o prato principal quando queimou o dedo.)
The students were whispering to each other when the teacher walked into the classroom. (Os alunos estavam cochichando um com o outro quando o professor entrou na sala.)
Lucas was waiting for the bus when he saw a famous actor. (Lucas estava esperando o ônibus quando ele viu um ator famoso.)

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
